'''Range Lead''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kapp Dendo|Dendo]] used during the [[Battle of Ithor]]. He used it to tell [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] that [[Gavin Darklighter]] had determined which [[Yorik-trema|transport]] was being used as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s command center on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].
